details: This package is a self-declared dependency-confusion proof of concept. Its postinstall hook runs beacon.cjs, which sends an HTTPS POST to hxxps://vmi3699893[.]contaboserver[.]net:8787/_ah/dc with an X-Beacon-Package: @c1-ease/core header. The JSON body reports only install metadata: package name, machine hostname, the package install path (__dirname), the current working directory, the npm user-agent and protocol. The TLS request is made with certificate validation disabled. index.js also fires the same beacon on require and exports a catch-all Proxy no-op shim so that imports of the real package name do not crash. No credentials, environment values, tokens or file contents are collected or transmitted. Version 99.0.1 on a scoped name with a 3 KB tarball is the version-squat delivery shape.
